title: How Deciding the Night Before Runs a Godly Man's Morning
caption:
Willpower is highest at night and lowest at 6 AM, which is exactly backwards from when most men try to use it. Decide then, run on the decision now.

Lay out what tomorrow needs before you sleep. Clothes out, gym bag by the door, Bible where your hand goes first instead of your phone. Put the alarm across the room so you have to stand to silence it. Write down the one hard thing you'll want to dodge, before it gets the chance to hide until noon.

A decided man doesn't negotiate with a tired one.

theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
